panels.title: Link budget formula (3GPP/ITU)
panels.description: Canonical ATG RX power — matches src/common/link_budget.py.

options.content:
**ATG topology:** ground BS ↔ aircraft UE.

`rx_power_dbm = EIRP + G_tx(az,el,tilt) + G_rx(az,el,roll,pitch)`
`             − PL − gaseous − rain − scint − pol − impl − fuselage`

- **PL:** TR 36.777 aerial path loss / FSPL helper in `spec3gpp/tr36777.py` (# TODO VERIFY Rel-18 NR-ATG TR)
- **gaseous / rain / scint:** ITU-R P.676 / P.618 (`itu_atmos.py`); refractivity k-factor: ITU-R P.453
- **RSRP / SINR:** TS 38.215 when measured; model path tags `[model]`
- **TA:** TS 38.213; **SE / MCS:** TS 38.214 / 28.552; **peak:** TS 38.306
- Labels: `[model]` link_budget · `[measured]`/`[oai]` softmodem · `[sionna]` RT when up
